recipes.name: Fruity Sweet and Sour Sauce
ingredients_raw: 0.5 cup white sugar, or to taste
0.5 cup white vinegar, or more to taste

steps.text: Mix the sugar, vinegar, maraschino cherry juice, and pineapple juice in a saucepan over medium-low heat, stirring to dissolve the sugar.

Place the cornstarch in a small bowl, and stir the water into it to make a smooth paste. Stir the cornstarch paste into the juice mixture, and bring to a simmer. Stir constantly until the mixture thickens, about 1 minute.

raw_recipe.headline: Fruity Sweet and Sour Sauce
raw_recipe.description: The secret to that addictive pink restaurant-style sweet and sour dipping sauce for egg rolls is left-over maraschino cherry juice! It takes only a few minutes to make a batch.

review.reviewBody: I've made this recipe twice. The trick to getting it to not taste so much like cherry is to add 1/4 cup of ketchup, or a little more if you prefer. My mom worked at a chinese restaurant and is the one who told me I was missing ketchup bcuz that's hwo they made it. Also, by personal preference I used crushed pinneapple w/juice and cheeries w/the juice and pureed/liquified it together in a magic bullet. It tasted so much like the restaurant style sweet and sour once I made the few adjustments! Very good!

Thought it needed some tang, so I added 2 T Ketchup. Didn't have the maraschino cherry juice so I made my own using 1/3 c water, 1/4 c white sugar, 2 T corn syrup, 1 t almond extract, and 3 drops red food coloring. This sauce was amazing!

YUM, YUM, YUM ?! This recipe is FANTASTIC!!! I made it for a huge Lua Party last weekend with Crab Rangoon. The sauce was "out of this world." Some recipes I'm seeing calls for adding tomato past . This is top-notch restaurant style Sweet & Sour sauce. I DID tweak mine some by adding a 1/4 up more pinapple juice and only a quarter cut of cherry juice. I also used apple cider vinegar not distilled white venegar (added more fruitness and twang). It wasn't as beautifully red, but more pink in color. However, it was to die for. I will add some red food coloring next time. Everyone loved it. It's a KEEPER! I'll use this for Sweet & Sour Chicken too.

I made this but I think it is far too sweet. Next time I did not add the cherry juice but replaced with more pineapple juice and added pineapple chunks. I also used apple cider vinegar instead of white. It turned out much better and tasted more like it should.

This is my favorite chinese sauce! A 5 star recipe! It seems as some people dont like to comment on friendly modifications for various reasons, such as lacking an ingredient and using a substitue, which can be helpful but they like to address a recipe with negativity and criticism. First, read the headine!, this is for a FRUITY sweet n sour sauce! If you dont like fruitiness, STOP right there and search the gazillions of sweet n sour recipes at hand. Second, recipes differ for various reasons, understand the reason for specific recipe, if that recipe is not for you keep searching, NO NEED TO CRITICIZE! Its about recipes not your personal likes & dislikes! This is a great recipe for those that want less sour boldness but its greatest appeal is for eggrolls! Who doesnt like the hot mustard sauce for eggrolls, yet it can be too overpowering for many, however this is where the more fruity, less sour sauce and the hot mustard sauce become a perfect combination for eggrolls, like reeses peanut butter cups, LOL! This recipe is my favorite among a host of sweet n sour sauces because I can use it straight up for my eggrolls, along with hot mustard sauce, as well I can do simple modifications for certain dishes depending on the degree of sour, heat or spice flavoring I might want and always wind up with a perfect sauce. ONE THING on pineapple, use fresh pineapple juice or chunks with recipes if possibe because the high acidity causes a leeching in cans that can give strong metallic presence in dishes, that actually throw off, the overall taste. Thank you very much for this recipe! I love it! By the way in days past, I remember the waitress bringing a 3 compartment lazy susan to the table. Hot mustard sauce, standard sweet n sour sauce and of course, THIS FAMOUS FRUITY SWEET N SOUR SAUCE! So yummy!

This was pretty good to me, much closer than anything else I've tried. The maraschino cherry juice added a little too much cherry flavor. But next time I will reduce the cherry juice to probably a tablespoon or 2. I will add a dash of soy sauce and a 1/4 tsp of MSG. I know MSG is not very 'good for you', but it really does jack up the flavor of whatever you are cooking. I will probably add 1/4 cup tomato sauce or a TBSP of tomato paste too. Thanks for the cherry juice idea though!

ALTER THE RECIPE AND THEN ITS WORTH 5 STARS.
CUT THE VINEGAR IN HALF AND IT'LL BE PERFECT.

To keep things simple I replaced the 1/2 cup of cherry juice and 1/2 cup of pineapple juice with a 1/2 cup of fruit punch. I used a brand called Purity. It is made from pineapple, cherry, and orange juice and an apricot puree. I also added a dash of garlic, onion, and ginger powder and soy sauce. Also, I added about a 1/4 of ketchup. It worked so well I'm convinced this is what they use at Chinese buffets. 5 STARS!
My family loved it. The ketchup really helped cut down that maraschino cherry flavor that my mom detests. My brother and I love the flavor of maraschino cherry so it didn't matter to us.
I made this tonight with a little cranberry juice in place of the cherry juice. I also added chunks of pineapple. Super easy and yummy. My kids found it slightly tart.

I didn't have any Maraschino cherries so I used a cuplet of sugarfree cherry jello. It worked just fine. I used Splenda instead of sugar. I am diabetic. I took the tip from others and used 1/4 cup of ketchup. The sauce is perfect. This is by far the best sweet and sour sauce that I have ever made. My thanks to Miss Sparkle. Johnny

This is close to what I used to make, I used dehydrated tart cherries tho. also I cooked it with the bell peppers and onions. the tart cherries and pineapple combined and tasted perfect and not like cherry. To each is own, but if you put ketchup in it your wrong, stop it!
it's great!

I made this exactly as written, no variations. It tastes exactly the sweet & sour sauce at my favorite Chinese restaurant. I have saved the recipe and will definitely make this many times again. I have looked everywhere for this sauce to make at home and I am so happy to have finally found it.
So easy & fast great on everything. Tastes just like a restaurant made it.
I did cut back on the marachino cherry juice and subst. ketchup for color...this was by far the best sweet and sour recipe I've found so far. Thank you!
I would omit the cherry juice altogether. I had to dump it out and start over because I couldn't get it to not taste like cherries.

With Yellow fruit punch and cranberry juice (what I had) it was exceptional, will do it again with those juice, didn't taste totally like sweet and sour sauce but was more unique I really just try it!! With eggrolls was perfect
not exact same taste this way but I used apple cider vinegar for this and it came out soooo good!
I really like this recipe. I added a little Sriracha sauce and pineapple bits and cherry bits. It is superb!
